LeaderboardEntry.title: LeaderboardEntry
LeaderboardEntry.description: PII-free public arcade high-score entry for Chudling Pong.

uid.description: Authenticated user UID owning this leaderboard entry.

playerName.description: Public display nickname shown on the leaderboard.

score.description: Best arcade score achieved by the player.

fireMode.description: Weapon mode used during the best run.

zappedCount.description: Total mosquitoes zapped during the best run.

bestCombo.description: Highest hit streak achieved during the best run.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the score was recorded.

/leaderboard/{entryId}.description: Public top-score leaderboard keyed by authenticated user UID (entryId == uid).
